stainless_430.name: 430 Ferritic Stainless Steel
stainless_430.description: Standard magnetic stainless steel base for modern induction-ready cookware.

cast_iron.description: High relative permeability and moderate conductivity. Excellent induction heating efficiency.

carbon_steel_1018.name: 1018 Carbon Steel
carbon_steel_1018.description: Wok and skillet material; high magnetic coupling with higher electrical conductivity.
